label: Whatever moves something exists at the reading world w
paraphrase: OPEN interface (B0), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: on the shared causality frame, whatever moves something in some respect (MovesIn, CAUSE_1, read at the reading world w, since the case's motion vocabulary is not world-indexed) exists at w. A mover exercising its moving there exists there. Nothing is said about any other world, about concreteness or about necessity.
